name: repoditor-desktop
description: A desktop save editor for R.E.P.O. .es3 save files.
author: Hans Valerie

scripts.package:tauri: npm run build:sidecar && tauri build --no-bundle -- --locked && node scripts/tauri/stage-tauri.mjs
scripts.test:e2e:recovery: npm run typecheck:e2e && playwright test e2e/tauri-recovery.spec.ts --output=build/recovery-checkpoint/native-e2e
scripts.test:e2e:tauri: npm run test:tauri && npm run typecheck:e2e && cross-env REPODITOR_E2E_EXECUTABLE=build/tauri-preview/repoditor-preview.exe playwright test e2e/tauri-preview.spec.ts e2e/tauri-upgrades.spec.ts e2e/tauri-run.spec.ts e2e/tauri-items.spec.ts e2e/tauri-maps.spec.ts e2e/tauri-cosmetics.spec.ts e2e/tauri-status.spec.ts --output=test-results/tauri-preview
scripts.dev:electron: wait-on http://localhost:5173 dist-electron/main.cjs && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron .
scripts.build: npm run clean:electron-output && tsc -b && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && vite build
scripts.test: npm run test:imports && npm run test:theme && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && npm run typecheck:electron-tests && vitest run
scripts.test:coverage: tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && npm run typecheck:electron-tests && vitest run --coverage
scripts.test:e2e: tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && npm run typecheck:e2e && playwright test e2e/workspace.spec.ts e2e/cosmetics.spec.ts e2e/persistence.spec.ts e2e/game-safety.spec.ts e2e/maps.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:packaged: npm run typecheck:e2e && cross-env REPODITOR_E2E_EXECUTABLE=release/win-unpacked/RepoDitor.exe playwright test e2e/package-smoke.spec.ts
scripts.build:sidecar: uv run --isolated --python 3.13 --project .. --locked --group package pyinstaller --noconfirm --clean --onedir --console --name repoditor-backend --paths python --distpath build/backend --workpath build/pyinstaller/work --specpath build/pyinstaller --collect-all UnityPy --collect-all TypeTreeGeneratorAPI --collect-all fmod_toolkit --collect-data archspec --hidden-import addressablestools --copy-metadata addressablestools python/repo_save_editor/desktop_api/__main__.py
scripts.package:dir: npm run clean:release-output && electron-builder --win dir && npm run package:verify
scripts.package:dir:signed: npm run clean:release-output && electron-builder --config electron-builder.release.cjs --win dir && npm run package:verify
scripts.package:installer: npm run installer:host && electron-builder --win nsis --prepackaged release/win-unpacked && npm run package:verify:installer
scripts.package:installer:signed: npm run installer:host:signed && electron-builder --config electron-builder.release.cjs --win nsis --prepackaged release/win-unpacked && npm run package:verify:installer
scripts.package: npm run build:sidecar && npm run build && npm run package:dir && npm run test:e2e:packaged && npm run package:installer
scripts.release:check: node scripts/release/check-release-version.mjs && npm run installer:ui:build && node --test installer/scripts/installer-config.test.mjs scripts/release/signing-config.test.mjs scripts/release/version-tooling.test.mjs
